html:
The heart of the home

What Is Living Room Design?

The living room is where the home comes together. Good design balances comfort, beauty and function so conversation, rest and everyday family life all feel natural.

We plan seating, TV and entertainment, colour and lighting as one composition. Furniture, finishes and styling then add character without making the room feel busy.

Room by room detail

What We Deliver

Eight coordinated decisions turn the room into a place that feels easy to use and complete.

Compact living rooms can use scaled furniture, wall-mounted elements and carefully planned storage to keep the floor clear.

01

Seating Layout Planning

Sofa placement, conversation groups and clear circulation.

02

TV & Entertainment Integration

Comfortable viewing angles, media console planning and cable management.

03

Colour Scheme Design

A cohesive palette and mood boards for the room.

04

Lighting Design

Ambient, task and decorative light for different activities.

05

Furniture Selection & Layout

Sofa, chairs and coffee table balanced to suit the room.

06

Decorative Styling

Art, mirrors, plants and rugs arranged without clutter.

07

Material & Finish Selection

Walls, flooring, curtains and feature walls chosen together.

08

Open-Plan Coordination

Living, dining and kitchen zones connected through furniture, colour and lighting.

A clear route forward

Our Design Process

Five focused steps take the room from conversation to a complete visual plan.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss how the room is used, who gathers there and what needs to change.

02

Site Measurement

We record walls, openings, services and existing furniture that may stay.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Seating, movement and the TV wall are resolved in a balanced plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

We bring together colour, finishes, lighting and furniture direction.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

You receive drawings, specifications and clear 3D views of the room.

Consultation to final design packageTypically 1–2 weeks from consultation to final design package.

Before we begin

Living Room Design FAQs

Short answers to common questions about layout, cost and timing.

Design consultation starts from around PKR 12,000. Full packages range from PKR 15,000–35,000 depending on size and complexity.

Keep a clear path through the room and choose furniture that fits the scale. A defined conversation area makes a compact room feel calmer.

The TV should sit at a comfortable viewing height with minimal glare. We plan seating, media storage and cable routes around it.

The best palette responds to daylight, room size and the mood you want. We build one cohesive scheme across walls, furniture and textiles.
